difficulty_reason: The chapter's capstone theorem: for an algebraic stack with finite inertia, constructs the uniform categorical moduli space f : X -> M as an algebraic space; builds the point-level equivalence relation, assembles the moduli map through the c/e/i (composition/unit/inverse) construction with the k-point fibre-product arguments, and concludes separated, quasi-compact, universal homeomorphism via the groupoid criteria.
